criteria.description: Cloud account/role/region/model match the accepted target; record exact probe source and run identity.
Direct two-turn InvokeModel completes tool_use then tool_result; final answer incorporates deterministic result.
InvokeModelWithResponseStream yields complete tool input, valid event ordering, stop reason and usage.
CountTokens has a measured result or a precise unsupported-model/API/permission disposition; no false exact estimate.
Optional forced-tool, beta/cache/thinking/image/document features each have a tested GO or explicit unsupported disposition; product scope follows the matrix.
Pre-call request/output/time limits enforced; actual use recorded, redacted evidence and temporary-resource cleanup verified.

required_bindings: exact business inputs and fixture references
trusted result artifact schema/hash and criterion predicates
evaluations.pass_rule: All required criteria satisfied for the accepted target and source. Optional capabilities may be unsupported only as explicitly permitted above; required core tool-loop/streaming cannot be waived. Missing evidence/cleanup never passes.
evaluations.failure_rule: Keep dependents blocked. Repair only within accepted scope and remaining limits; changed scope uses an amendment. No fabricated receipt or human fallback.
evaluations.producer_owner: 6851: probe harness and sanitized evidence. Engine binding/dispatcher must be prepared before admission; probe report merge is not GO.

criteria.description: All required child PRs merged with exact-head review and required CI; #790 resolved by linked evidence without duplicate implementation.
Running gateway and served CLI provenance match accepted release containing all child changes; source/main SHA alone is insufficient.
Clean cloud client uses dedicated scoped login with no ambient control credentials; org and deployment match.
Desktop model list is permitted and Claude-specific without changing generic client discovery; cross-org/disallowed requests denied.
Non-streamed tool loop preserves nested schema, tool choice, tool IDs/results and supported optional fields; result incorporated.
Streamed tool input reconstructs exactly; terminal events, stop reasons and errors are correct; cancellation never replays tool actions.
CountTokens matches proven direct behavior or explicit accepted unsupported mode; permission failure is distinguishable.
Setup is idempotent and deployment-pinned; refresh succeeds, helper stdout is token-only and unrelated settings survive.
Usage/request IDs identify the smoke user and org; provider token counts and supported cache usage remain intact.
Existing Claude Code, Codex routing, gateway live tests and CLI onboarding regressions pass for accepted revisions.
Every mandatory case has an outcome and authenticated evidence; limits enforced, failures redacted, cleanup complete.
